description: An E2E encrypted mailbox for AI agents: claim an address, send and receive sealed agent-to-agent messages, register a self-hosted endpoint. MCP server included.
name: @reneturcios/agentmail

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of ['bin/agentmail.js','python/agentmail_client/__init__.py','python/agentmail_client/__main__.py','python/agentmail_client/mail_crypto.py','python/agentmail_client/client.py','python/agentmail_client/mcp_server.py']){if(!fs.existsSync(f))throw new Error('missing '+f)}console.log('build ok: all sources present')"
scripts.test: python3 -m pip install -q --break-system-packages --ignore-installed cryptography httpx pytest && python3 -m pytest tests -q
